Name: Relaxing Bundles
Author: tcjaime
Description:
News!  CaptainWolfe11 has updated this mod so it now works for all bundles!  Go check it out!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26920]Relaxing Bundles Redux at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]

I love the community center bundles; I really do.  But after multiple games, grinding the bundles over and over again became a chore.  So, I created this mod to simplify the bundling.  It is also useful if you want to experience the bundles without having to fish, mine, forage, etc.  And once you get golden titles in all the rooms, you can finish the bundles in any order you want.  So if you want the greenhouse first, you can have the greenhouse first. 

[font=Comic Sans MS][i]NOTE: I recommend you only complete one bundle a day.  The game can get 'wonky' if you have too many cut scenes happening at once. *[/i]
[/font]
This mod only works for the standard bundles, not the new option for random bundles. **  It will replace the item required in a bundle with 20-25 bags of wheat flour while leaving the rewards the same.  It does not change the safe's gold requirements. 

Pierre sells wheat flour for 100g each so each item in the bundle will cost you between 2000 and 2500 gold. 

To install, download the mod, unzip it, and put the RelaxingBundles folder in your Stardew Valley / Mods folder.
To remove, delete the RelaxingBundles from your Stardew Vally / Mod folder.

This is my first Nexus Mod, so let me know if you see anything out of the ordinary.  :)

*Update: 09/09/2020:  I have received a bug report about wonkiness if you complete multiple bundles in the same day.  So for safety, I recommend you only complete one bundle a day.

**Update 12/25/2020":  Yes, random is indeed random.  Thank you, helpful family member, who felt obligated to point this out to me over Christmas dinner.
